text:
maria: Quick sync on the wavefront sprint — kernel + continuous batching + KV warmup. Milestones: kernel PRs merged by Wed, batch perf tests green by Fri, KV warmup baseline rollout Mon. Blockers: kernel CR needs perf numbers, CI flaky on A100. Owners: @alex (kernel), @sam (batching), @chloe (kv). Can owners ack and drop short status?

alex: Acked. I'll push perf numbers today — seeing ~12% token throughput locally on the hotpath. Investigating CI flakes (looks like driver timeout on A100).

sam: Running batch suite now. Tail latencies spike for long seqs (>= 1024). Lowering batch window helps but reduces throughput. Will open a short experiment CR with param tuning. cc @jordan for infra repro.

chloe: KV warmup plan ready, but rollout needs an infra config flip for prefix caching on the canary pool. @infra-team — can we get the toggle enabled for cluster-canary-3?

jordan: Repro steps I used: `./bench --seq 2048 --concurrency 8 --warmup=on`. If infra flips the flag I can run a canary sweep. I can also flip temporarily via: `kubectl patch cm runtime-config -p '{"kv.warmup.enabled":"true"}'`.

deploy-bot: deploy-bot: Canary deploy started for warmup baseline on `cluster-canary-3` (id: canary-20260317-12).

maria: Nice — if kernel perf >10% and batching param experiment doesn't regress tail latencies we can greenlight canary. Also need @eng-sre to silence noisy alerts during the warmup rollout (CPU promos).

alex: Uploaded perf logs to the perf bucket (link: https://redwood.perf/artefacts/3812345678). Raw numbers attached in the artifact.

sam: CR: `batch/exp/short-window` created, assigning to @chloe for kv interaction check. Small change: `batch.max_window_ms=30` default->20.

chloe: Will review the CR, focusing on interactions with KV prefetch and LRU handshake. ETA EOD. Quick config snippet for rollout:
```
kv.warmup.enabled=true
batch.max_tokens=1024
```

maria: Great. If no new blockers, let's lock milestones by EOD tomorrow. Ping here with any regressions. :thumbsup:

jordan: I'll queue the canary bench once infra confirms the toggle. Happy to pair if anyone wants to walk through the repro.

alex: One ask — can someone from infra expose the A100 driver logs from yesterday's CI run? helps narrow the timeout cause.

chloe: Noted. I'll coordinate with infra and post back.

maria: Thanks all — short follow-ups ok in-thread, otherwise we'll capture blockers in the sprint board.
